attribution.note: Zitron states and endorses this conditional prediction in his own article.

semantics.note: The normalised claim and its conditions preserve the demand/adoption antecedent, three named companies, investor response and unspecified horizon.

contract.note: The broad demand shortfall and revenue-driven investor backlash are fair ordinary readings. Defining a qualifying slowdown and market response requires interpretation because the speaker supplied no thresholds.

evidence.note: Timely Microsoft disclosure weighs against the antecedent, but covers Azure broadly. It is neither independent verification nor a contradiction of the conditional forecast.
Official adoption statistics show sector and firm-size differences. Survey scope and wording changes limit comparisons; they do not establish the required broad demand slowdown.

Reports spending-related investor backlash against Amazon and Microsoft, alongside strong demand and a different response to Google. It does not establish the conditional chain across all three firms.

reviews.rationale: The packet does not establish the demand-shortfall antecedent or the specified subsequent backlash across all three companies. Spending concerns amid strong demand do not satisfy that chain. No deadline was stated, and the early-resolution rule is unmet, so the conditional forecast remains unscored.
